name: design
description: The design plugin — color science and palettes, typography systems, and design-system exports in one install: OKLCH ramps and verification, the 15-voice type system, Material Design token grammar, the DESIGN.md/Figma Make/Google Stitch export bundles a generative design agent consumes, artifact-styling-rules (theme/token/type/mermaid/shell doctrine for Claude Artifacts), and token-feature-intake-rules (visual/token feature-ticket intake schema).
